note: Routing table for model-router. Ranks: haiku 1, sonnet 2, opus 3, fable 4. Efforts: low 1, medium 2, high 3, xhigh 4, max 5. Edit freely; the hooks re-read this file on every prompt.

quick.why: short question with a known answer

write.why: drafting prose; small slips are cheap to fix

edit.why: a scoped change with a clear target

risky.why: money, security, data or uptime at stake

review.why: cheap models flag correct work as wrong

research.why: facts from several sources; cheap models get more wrong

agents.scout: model-router:scout (Haiku 5.5 · low): find, read and list; reports paths, quotes and line numbers
agents.runner: model-router:runner (Haiku 5.5 · low): runs tests and commands, reports the exact command and its output
agents.builder: model-router:builder (Sonnet 5.5 · medium): one scoped edit from a brief, then runs the brief's check
agents.reviewer: model-router:reviewer (Opus 5.5 · high): risky diffs, and any step that failed twice
